[T-SYS] Two questions in this one turn:
1. From YOUR SYSTEM CONTEXT (not a tool), what is the instance ID that built your system prompt / runs this conversation loop?
2. Call execute-tool with toolName='self-instance-id' and instanceId='hermes' (instanceId='hermes' is REQUIRED on this call - never omit it) to read the instance ID the TOOL executes on.
Reply with EXACTLY two lines, nothing else:
SystemPrompt: <instance id from your context>
ToolExec: <instance id the self-instance-id tool returned>
